Pay Mockingbird with Surveillance Team, Aunt May, Spider-Tracer — situational/redundant cards. Keep Backflip (defense) and Interrogation Room (cheap to play next with Peter's mental resource) in hand.
Play Interrogation Room paid with Peter Parker's Scientist resource, keeping Backflip in hand for defense.
Use the free Scientist resource; keep Backflip in hand as an attack-damage interrupt for later.
Use Mockingbird's attack now — she's at full HP and Rhino is stunned, so this damage is free tempo. Consequential damage leaves her at 2 HP.
Flip to Spider-Man to attack with basic power this turn; Rhino is stunned so he won't attack me in the villain phase despite me being in hero form.
Attack with basic power — free damage while Rhino is stunned and can't retaliate meaningfully.
Keep Backflip — it's a 0-cost interrupt that prevents all attack damage, perfect insurance against Rhino's attacks or Charge!.
Play Black Cat — cheap ally that digs for mental-resource cards and adds an attack/thw body. Keep Web-Shooter and Backflip in hand.
Keep Backflip (defense) and Web-Shooter (3 wild resources over time — highest value per card). Pay with For Justice! and Avengers Mansion, both of which I can't use soon.
Play Web-Shooter — a permanent that gives 3 wild resources over time. Pay with Enhanced Spider-Sense, keeping Backflip (free all-damage prevention vs Rhino's attacks).
Pay with Enhanced Spider-Sense; keep Backflip since it's free to play (0 cost) and prevents all damage from an attack — better insurance vs Rhino.
Black Cat attacks with no consequential damage — free damage on Rhino.
Mockingbird attacks for 1; she'll survive at 1 HP and can attack once more next turn before her last consequential damage.
Basic attack with Spider-Man — keep pressuring Rhino; he's stunned earlier so he's been passive. Threat is low (1/7), no need to thwart.

Stay in hero form — full HP, taking Rhino's attack draws a card via Spider-Sense, and it keeps threat off the main scheme. Mockingbird will get one last attack next turn before her consequential damage defeats her.
Keep Backflip — free-to-play defense that prevents all attack damage. Draw back up to 5.
Mockingbird is at 1 HP with only one more attack left in her (which would kill her via consequential damage anyway). Trading her to absorb Rhino's full attack preserves my HP and Black Cat.
Take 2 damage instead of adding threat — I'm at full HP and the main scheme threshold is only 7. HP is the more renewable resource here.

Swinging Web Kick (8 damage) finishes Rhino stage 1 (7 HP) now — only 1 damage wasted, and killing him sooner stops his attacks. Stage 2 will reveal Breakin' & Takin' (hazard side scheme), which I'll clear with Spider-Tracer when Hydra Bomber dies.

Pay with Emergency, Webbed Up, and Interrogation Room — keeps Backflip (free defense) and the Web-Shooter counter (to pay for Spider-Tracer next, which will clear Breakin' & Takin' when Hydra Bomber dies).

Attach Spider-Tracer to Hydra Bomber, paid with a Web-Shooter counter (keeps Backflip for defense). When Bomber dies, the tracer removes 3 threat — exactly clearing Breakin' & Takin' (3 threat, hazard icon adding an encounter card every round).
Use a Web-Shooter counter (wild) to keep Backflip in hand — it prevents all attack damage and Rhino stage 2 now hits for 3 base.
Black Cat attacks Rhino for free damage (no consequential damage) before spending my basic attack on Hydra Bomber.
Basic attack kills Hydra Bomber exactly (2 damage on 2 HP); Spider-Tracer then removes 3 threat, exactly clearing Breakin' & Takin' and its hazard icon (extra encounter card each round).

Clears Breakin' & Takin' entirely (3 threat exactly) — removes the hazard icon that would deal an extra encounter card every round. Main scheme only has 2 threat anyway, so option 1 would waste damage.
Stay in hero form — main scheme at 2/7 can't afford the villain scheming (would add ~4 threat), and Backflip plus Spider-Sense (draw on attack) makes the incoming attack safe.
Only one card in hand (Backflip) — keep it as free all-damage prevention vs Rhino's 3-ATK stage 2. Draw 4 more.

Convert the unavoidable per-round threat into damage — main scheme threshold is only 7 (2/7 now), so threat is the tight clock. I'm at 8 HP with REC 3 to heal later, and Backflip will fully prevent Rhino's attack this phase anyway.
Don't exhaust Spider-Man or sacrifice Black Cat — I'll play Backflip in the damage window to prevent the attack entirely, keeping Spider-Man ready for next turn's basic attack.
Backflip prevents all 5 damage from this boosted attack — perfect use of the card, staying at 7 HP with Spider-Man unexhausted.
Nick Fury is the strongest play: 4 damage entry plus a 2-damage attack, and he can defend Rhino's next attack as a disposable body. Plan to pay without the in-play Web-Shooter counter.
Pay with Genius + Heroic Intuition + a Web-Shooter counter — keeps the second Web-Shooter card in hand (cost 1 for 3 future wild resources) over Heroic Intuition.

Guaranteed 4 damage on Rhino — with Fury's attack (2), Black Cat (1) and my basic (2), this turn deals 9 total, dropping Rhino to 6. Card draw is tempting but Fury leaves at end of round, so maximize his damage now.
Nick Fury attacks for 2 — his consequential damage doesn't matter since he's discarded at end of round anyway.
Black Cat's attack is free (no consequential damage) — keep chipping Rhino down.
Basic attack — threat is safe at 2/7, all damage goes to Rhino (8 HP left).

Can't afford Web-Shooter (only card in hand, can't pay for itself), and no other actions. Stay hero — alter-ego would let Rhino scheme toward the 7-threat threshold. Draw up and keep the Web-Shooter for next turn.
Keep Web-Shooter — it's a cheap (1 cost) permanent resource engine. Draw 4 cards.
Nick Fury is discarded at the end of this round regardless, so blocking with him costs nothing — he absorbs the attack entirely (excess beyond his 2 HP is lost unless Rhino has overkill).
Critically needed — I'm at 4 HP and Gang-Up would make Rhino attack again (3+ ATK), which could defeat me. Cancelling the treachery with Enhanced Spider-Sense is the safe play.

Pay with The Power of Justice — as a generic payment it's just 1 resource, and its 2-for-Justice upside only matters if I draw a Justice card. Keeping Helicarrier, Webbed Up, Heroic Intuition, and Web-Shooter as plays. Not using the in-play Web-Shooter counter since it would stay exhausted through my next turn.

Rhino at 6 HP — I can deal 3 this turn (hero 2 + Black Cat 1) leaving him at 3, and Webbed Up prevents his attack this round and stuns him next round. Turn 6: Black Cat (1) + basic attack (2) = exactly lethal, with the stun covering the villain phase. Keeps me at 4 HP safely.
Black Cat's free attack first — chip Rhino from 6 to 5.
Basic attack brings Rhino to 3 HP — exactly lethal next turn with Black Cat (1) + basic (2). Webbed Up prevents his attack this round and stuns him, so staying hero at 4 HP is safe.
Hand is empty. Stay hero: Webbed Up converts Rhino's attack into a stun this round, threat at 3/7 stays safe, and next turn Black Cat (1) + basic attack (2) = exactly 3 damage for the win.
Threat at 4/7 still has margin (I plan to win next turn with Black Cat + basic attack for exactly 3), whereas 1 damage matters more at 4 HP. Rhino's attack is neutralized by Webbed Up anyway.

Pay for Helicarrier with the three cards I'm least likely to need this turn (Aunt May at full HP, Interrogation Room, Enhanced Spider-Sense), keeping Black Cat (to play next with the discount + Peter Parker's mental) and Swinging Web Kick (the 8-damage finisher) in hand.

Use Helicarrier's discount so Swinging Web Kick costs 2, letting me afford both Web Kick and Mockingbird this turn.

Black Cat's exact 1 damage finishes Rhino stage 1 without overkill, revealing stage 2.
Deal 8 damage to fresh stage 2 now (15→7); the remaining three cards exactly cover its cost. Faster stage kills mean fewer villain phases — better than Mockingbird's stun line.

Take the 2 damage (6→4 HP) rather than add threat — the main scheme's threshold is only 7 and the hazard side scheme already brings extra encounter cards; I can defend attacks with DEF 3 and heal later as Peter Parker.

Vulture hits for 3 — taking it would leave me at 1 HP and force an alter-ego flip while the scheme climbs. Black Cat blocks (her 2 HP absorbs the hit, excess lost since Vulture has no overkill), keeping me at 4 HP to stay in hero form.
Discount the next card — Daredevil at 3 cost lets me afford him plus Interrogation Room this turn.
Play Daredevil with the Helicarrier discount (4→3) — he kills Hydra Bomber this turn and serves as a blocker in the villain phase.

Pay Daredevil's discounted cost with Power of Justice + Web-Shooter, keeping First Aid and Interrogation Room — then play Interrogation Room (its threat removal fights the acceleration clock) paying with First Aid.
Play Interrogation Room as a permanent threat-removal engine (paying with First Aid, the one-shot), then Daredevil's kill on Hydra Bomber will trigger it automatically for 1 extra threat removal.

Kill Hydra Bomber exactly (2 damage), removing an attacker permanently and triggering Interrogation Room for automatic threat removal; Daredevil can then block Rhino in the villain phase while Spider-Man defends Vulture's attack for zero damage.
No side scheme can be cleared with 1 damage (all sit at 3 threat), so reduce the main scheme directly — it's the loss condition and gains 2+ per round from acceleration.

Stay Spider-Man — flipping would let Rhino and Vulture scheme for ~4-6 threat against a 7-threshold scheme. In hero form I defend cleanly: Daredevil blocks Rhino (dies, excess lost), Spider-Man defends Vulture for 0 damage.
Threat goes to 3/7 — safe — while taking 2 damage instead would drop me to 2 HP right before Rhino (3 ATK) and Vulture (3 ATK) attack.

Daredevil (2 HP) blocks Rhino — excess damage is lost. Then Spider-Man defends Vulture's 3 ATK with DEF 3 for 0 damage, keeping me at 4 HP through both attacks. Either blocking order sacrifices Daredevil, so pick the one that costs me no HP.
Spider-Man's DEF 3 exactly cancels Vulture's 3 ATK — zero damage, staying at 4 HP.
Helicarrier pays back 1 resource every turn for the rest of the game; Interrogation Room only triggers on minion kills (1 threat each). Keep the stronger permanent engine.
